_comment: Already-fetched, READ-ONLY inputs for the four scans of a wholly invented organisation. This is what lets the wizard run end to end with no live credentials: whoever has access produces a bundle once, and the wizard (and every test) reads it.

database._comment: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA names, plus the first lines of each migration file. The engine's own schemas (dbo/sys/INFORMATION_SCHEMA) are present on purpose — the scan must drop them rather than put the database's plumbing in an org's registry.

migration_headers.text:
/* Dispatch: driver handover and shipment legs */
CREATE TABLE dispatch.driver (id INT);

# Warehouse: cycle count staging for the shipment reconciliation
CREATE TABLE warehouse.count (id INT);

directory._comment: GROUP DISPLAY NAMES ONLY. Mixed shapes on purpose — bare strings and Graph-shaped group objects — so the fixture exercises read_group_display_names, the single door into the directory scan. No user object appears here, and none can: the reader raises on any entry carrying a user attribute.

forge._comment: Repo and project names only. A project name is an explicit act of grouping; a repo word has to recur before it counts as a system.

wiki._comment: Current page names. Only the LEADING segment is read — that is where this org has been putting its top-level categorisation all along.
